the-kingdom-of-aldaria.name: The Kingdom of Aldaria
the-kingdom-of-aldaria.description: The Kingdom of Aldaria is the nation where Mistria is located. Aldaria is a monarchy, and is lead by King Kelinien[1]. Based on  Quest descriptions, Aldaria is a non-landlocked kingdom, featuring rural regions, and mountainous areas.Before the events of Fields of Mistria, the kingdom was impacted by a major earthquake, and is in the process of rebuilding.

balor's-wagon.name: Balor's Wagon
balor's-wagon.description: Balor's Wagon is a shop run by Balor located in Mistria, north of The Player's Farm, and west of Celine's Cottage. Various items can be purchased here, including Crafting Scrolls and Recipes, Crafting and Cooking resources, Cosmetics, and Cooked Dishes.

upgrade.text: Reach later seasons, complete various  Story Quests

bathhouse-exterior(-spring)-bathhouse-ex.description: The Bathhouse is located in the northeast of Mistria, above  The Clinic, and is run by Juniper. Also home to Juniper's faithful companion Dozy, The Player can use the baths there to restore their  (Health) and  (Stamina).

the-bell-tower.name: The Bell Tower
the-bell-tower.description: The Bell Tower is a building that is inaccessible until late in the main story. It is located in the central, western portion of town. There is a  Woodcrafting workbench just east of the tower in a small courtyard, where Ryis and Hayden can both be seen working frequently. The workbench can be used by The Player for Woodcrafting.

the-blacksmith's-shop.name: The Blacksmith's Shop
the-blacksmith's-shop.description: The Blacksmith's Shop is located in Town and is run by March and Olric. The Player can use The Anvil in front of the forge outside to craft  Tools,  Equipment, and  Weapons.

images.caption: The Blacksmith's Shop Exterior in  Spring
The Blacksmith's Shop Exterior in  Summer

caldarus'-house.name: Caldarus' House
caldarus'-house.description: Caldarus' House is Caldarus' residence, located in the eastern section of The Deep Woods. It becomes accessible after gaining access to The Deep Woods.

the-capital.name: The Capital
the-capital.description:
The Capital is a city within  The Kingdom of Aldaria that - while not currently seen directly - is often mentioned by various townsfolk (in particular Ryis), as well as in descriptions for  Quests.
The Capital is home to Ryis' (and presumably Landen's) family, as well as the current location of Adeline and Eiland's parents (the Baron and Baroness of Mistria). The Capital is also home to The King, and possibly other members of The Royal Family.

the-carpenter's-shop.name: The Carpenter's Shop
the-carpenter's-shop.description: The Carpenter's Shop is located just outside of Town, in The Eastern Road and is run by Ryis.

images.caption: The Carpenter's Shop, as it appears at the start of Fields of Mistria.
The Carpenter's Shop, once it's been upgraded.
The interior of Carpenter Shop's first floor.
The interior of Carpenter Shop's second floor. Home to Ryis and Landen's bedrooms.

celine's-cottage.name: Celine's Cottage
celine's-cottage.description: Celine's Cottage is Celine's residence, located between The Town, and The Player's Farm. It is east of  Balor's Wagon.

the-chicken-statue.name: The Chicken Statue
the-chicken-statue.description: The Chicken Statue is located on the western side of Sweetwater Farm. Interacting with it with more than   1 Shiny Bead in your inventory will allow you to donate to it in multiples of   10 or   100.

Clinic Exterior( Summer)

clinic-exterior(-spring)-clinic-exterior.description: The Clinic is located to the northeast of Mistria, below  The Bathhouse and above The  General Store. It is run by Valen, the town's doctor. It acts as a clinic and store in addition to being her place of residence.

the-dragon-forge.name: The Dragon Forge
the-dragon-forge.description: Dragon-forging uses Blacksmithing - as well as  Blacksmithing skill perks - however recipes are instead unlocked via quest progression, rather than by skill level.

images.caption: "It doesn't seem useable at the moment. Perhaps there is a hint in one of the other rooms"
The room containing the lit Dragon Forge

errol's-cabin.name: Errol's Cabin
errol's-cabin.description:
Errol's Cabin is Errol's residence, located along the river in The Narrows, south of The Museum.
The exterior of the cabin is fairly plain, to the left a small garden, wherein Errol grows crops according to the season, to the right a  Pomegranate Tree which fruits in  Winter.

images.caption: The Farm, as it appears on The Player's map at the start of Fields of Mistria
The Farm, as it appears on The Player's map after expansion

farmhouse.name: Farmhouse
farmhouse.description: When starting Fields of Mistria The Farmhouse comes equipped with a few basic furnishings that have functional elements:

images.caption: Exterior of The Player's starting farmhouse
Interior of The Player's starting farmhouse

the-general-store.name: The General Store
the-general-store.description: The General Store is run by Nora and Holt, with Celine working part-time. The General Store is the main method of obtaining seasonal seeds, and is currently the only location to sell any Weapons.

images.caption: The General Store, as it appears at the start of Fields of Mistria.
The General Store Exterior in  Spring
The General Store Exterior in  Summer
The General Store Exterior in  Fall
The General Store Exterior in  Winter

hayden's-shop.name: Hayden's Shop
hayden's-shop.description: Hayden's Shop is owned and operated by Hayden. The shop specializes in items that utilize the Ranching skill, as well as Animals. The Player can adopt animals (assuming they have the correct buildings on their own Farm), put their animals in daycare, or sell their animals. The shop is within Hayden's house, which is located on the path just West of The Player's farm.

the-horse-statue-the-horse-statue-(-wint.name:
The Horse Statue
The Horse Statue ( Winter)
the-horse-statue-the-horse-statue-(-wint.description: Once The Player recieves the  Story Quest "Find the Weathervane" quest from Hayden, The Horse Statue can be found on the western side of The Narrows.

the-sleeping-dragon-inn.name: The Sleeping Dragon Inn
the-sleeping-dragon-inn.description: The Sleeping Dragon Inn is run by Hemlock, Josephine, and Reina. Hemlock is The Inn's Co-Owner and Bartender. Josephine is the Co-Owner. Reina is the Head Cook.

images.caption: The Inn, as it appears at the start of Fields of Mistria.

the-sleeping-dragon-inn.theme: Glowing Hearth (6 AM - 8 PM)Blazing Hearth (8 PM- 2 AM)

the-lighthouse.name: The Lighthouse
the-lighthouse.description: The Lighthouse is a currently inaccessible building located to the southeastern side of The Beach, atop a small hill.Currently it has no known purpose, or use.

images.caption: The Lighthouse Broken Exterior in  Winter

the-manor-house.name: The Manor House
the-manor-house.description: The Manor House is located on the northern most point of Mistria's town. Adeline, Eiland, and Elsie live in the Manor House.

images.caption: The Manor House (highlighted in red), as it appears on the Player's map.

the-mill.name: The Mill
the-mill.description: The Mill is a production building located just east of the  Request Board in Mistria.At first, The Mill is boarded up and inaccessible. The Mill is unlocked following completion of the  Story Quest "The Mill  Restoration Project".

images.caption: The Mill, as it appears at the start of Fields of Mistria.

the-mines.name: The Mines
the-mines.description: Much like Caldarus' Shrine on The Farm, this dragon statue can be used to exchange  Essence for Skill Perks for The Mining and Combat skills.

images.caption: Location of The Mines on the map

the-ancient-ruins.name: The Ancient Ruins
the-ancient-ruins.description: To open the final seal you will need to craft these items at the  The Dragon Forge:

the-deep-earth.name: The Deep Earth
the-deep-earth.description: To progress to the next biome, The Player must complete  "The Fire Tablet",  "Procuring the Sealing Scroll", and  "Breaking The Fire Seal".

images.caption: The first floor within The Deep Earth

the-lava-caves.name: The Lava Caves
the-lava-caves.description: To progress to the next biome, The Player must complete  "Creating The Void Mass", and  "Breaking the Ruins Seal".

images.caption: The first floor within The Lava Caves

the-tide-caverns.name: The Tide Caverns
the-tide-caverns.description: To complete  "The Earth Tablet" and break The Earth Seal, the following offerings are required:

images.caption: The first floor within The Tide Caverns

the-upper-mines.name: The Upper Mines
the-upper-mines.description: The Upper Mines consist of floors 1floors 1-19, and is the first biome The Player will encounter when exploring 0The Mines.

images.caption: The first floor within The Upper Mines

mistria.name: Mistria
mistria.description: Mistria is a town nestled amidst lush forests and tranquil shores in Fields of Mistria. This town serves as the central setting for The Player as they embark on a journey of restoration and discovery.

images.caption: The town of Mistria, as it appears on the Player's map.
The town of Mistria, in  Spring

the-museum.name: The Museum
the-museum.description: The Museum is located to the west of Mistria in The Narrows. It is run by Errol, The Museum's Curator and member of Mistria's Historical Society. The Player can donate certain items they come across over the course of the game here for varying rewards, such as  Tesserae and   Renown.

the-overworld.name: The Overworld
the-overworld.description: The Overworld is a catch-all-term used on The Fields of Mistria Wiki, for any location in Fields of Mistria that is not within 0The Mines.

the-request-board.name: The Request Board
the-request-board.description: Quests, also referred to as  Story Quests, or  Requests are set objectives which provide The Player with certain rewards upon completion. These objectives will vary from quest to quest. Multiple quests can be active at once, and they do not expire. The full details and current progress of all active quests are viewable in the corresponding  Quests tab in The Journal menu.

a-rejuvenating-fountain.name: A Rejuvenating Fountain
a-rejuvenating-fountain.description: Each Rejuvenating Fountain restores   20 Health and   20 Stamina. Each fountain can be used once per day.

seridia's-house.name: Seridia's House
seridia's-house.description: Seridia's House is Seridia's residence, located at the northern end of The Western Ruins. It becomes accessible after completion of The Mines' Questline.

the-stone-refinery.name: The Stone Refinery
the-stone-refinery.description: The Stone Refinery is a production workbench located just inside 0The Mines once built.The Stone Refinery is available following completion of the  Story Quest  "Stone Refinery", made available once The Player reaches Town Rank  Lvl. 55.

sweetwater-farm.name: Sweetwater Farm
sweetwater-farm.description: Sweetwater Farm is owned by Hayden. It lies directly west of The Player's Farm.

images.caption: Sweetwater Farm, as it appears on the Player's map

tackle-shop.name: Tackle Shop
tackle-shop.description: The Tackle Shop is located on The Beach and is run by Terithia, the back section of the interior also serves as her home.

the-beach.name: The Beach
the-beach.description: The Beach is the southern-most location in Fields of Mistria. It lies south of Hayden's Sweetwater Farm and southwest of The Player's Farm.

images.caption: The Beach, as it appears on The Player's map

the-deep-woods-the-deep-woods.name:
The Deep Woods
The Deep Woods
the-deep-woods-the-deep-woods.description:
The Deep Woods is a location in Fields of Mistria. It lies north of The Eastern Road.
The staircase leading to The Deep Woods from The Eastern Road is inaccessible until The Player completes  Story Quest  "Breaking The Fire Seal" and is able to remove the thick vines blocking the path.

images.caption: The Deep Woods, as it appears on The Player's map before they gain access.
The Deep Woods, as it appears on The Player's map after they gain access.

the-dragonsworn-glade.name: The Dragonsworn Glade
the-dragonsworn-glade.description: The Dragonsworn Glade is a location in Fields of Mistria, accessed during  Eiland's Heart Quest "The Glade".

the-eastern-road.name: The Eastern Road
the-eastern-road.description: The Eastern Road is east of Mistria and is northeast of the Player's Farm.

images.caption: The Eastern Road, as it appears at the start of Fields of Mistria.
The Eastern Road, as it appears on the Player's map

the-narrows.name: The Narrows
the-narrows.description: The Narrows is a location in Fields of Mistria. It lies to the west of the town of Mistria, north of Sweetwater Farm, east of The Western Ruins, and south of The Summit.

images.caption: The Narrows, as it appears on the Player's map

the-summit.name: The Summit
the-summit.description: The Summit is an unlockable location in Fields of Mistria north of The Narrows, initially inaccessible until the Player completes the  Story Quest "Beautification of Mistria".

images.caption: The Summit, as it appears on the Player's map.

the-western-ruins.name: The Western Ruins
the-western-ruins.description: The Western Ruins is the western-most zone in Fields of Mistria.

images.caption: The Western Ruins, as it appears on the Player's map

the-wishing-well.name: The Wishing Well
the-wishing-well.description: The Wishing Well is behind a large rock in The Eastern Road. A  Copper Pickaxe (or better) is needed to break it and access The Well.
